created_prompt:
Devise a three-year plan. This plan must include concrete, achievable steps. The plan is for Julie, who posts cooking videos online. She has a large following (1.2M people), and she focuses on quick, healthy recipes. Julie has a limited budget and limited time, as she works four days per week. 
The plan needs to help her grow her presence/following online, as well as publish a cookbook. She is unsure between traditional publishing and self-publishing, so you should recommend the best option for her specific situation.
